summary: The r3 cache, recovery, usage logging, and error logging changes pass focused tests. The IM3 markdown scrub can remove all lesson content after a personal-detail label.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] review-a: `stripPersonDetails` removes the entire remainder of lesson markdown after a `Student:`, `Teacher:`, or other recognized label, up to the next label or end of input.
